items: You can cast the soundsystem spell anywhere on a stump's cut top, not just its middle; the 🎶 and its hold prompt show when you're on it
Stumps grow more irregular: wobblier cuts, notches, off-centre hearts and uneven rings
Far-off stump wisps are small soft glows that fade with distance, not big squares
The spell's rainbow analyser is an even circle round the stump, no longer longer at the bottom
